strings.name: Kaja Kallas
strings.role: EU foreign-policy high representative · Commission vice-president
strings.summary: A competition lawyer turned Estonian and European parliamentarian, Kallas became Estonia’s first woman prime minister in 2021. She advocated greater aid to Ukraine and European defense spending after Russia’s full-scale invasion. In December 2024 she became EU foreign-policy high representative and Commission vice-president, working across diplomacy, security and enlargement amid differing national interests.
